title: Hero Gear
description: Hero equipment: crafting, enhancement and how to prioritize it.
sources: Kingshot Optimizer hero guide (Olive page), shared by user

entries.name: Gear is fully portable, no per-hero synergy
entries.summary: Hero gear is fully portable between heroes and there are NO synergies between specific hero skills and specific gear. When you replace a hero, move the gear to the new one. So the choice of gear can be decoupled from the choice of which hero to invest in.

details.implication: Don't build gear 'for a specific hero' (e.g. Olive); build it well and move it around.

entries.name: Prioritize gear by troop type, not by hero
entries.summary: The same stat is worth different amounts on different troop types (e.g. +1 health is worth much more on infantry than on cavalry, due to base stats and combat targeting logic). So prioritize gear investment per troop type (infantry/cavalry/archer), not per hero.

entries.name: Priority gear pieces to upgrade first
entries.summary: When upgrading hero gear, upgrade these pieces first for each troop type: Infantry -> Gloves and Shroud; Cavalry (Lancer) -> Armet and Boots; Archer (Marksman) -> Faceplate and Riders.

details.terminology: The game labels cavalry gear as 'Lancer' and archer gear as 'Marksman'.

entries.name: Gear enhancement point requirements per level
entries.summary: Enhancement Points needed to raise a single gear piece by one level, per rarity tier (Grey, Green, Blue, Purple, Gold). Higher rarities keep leveling past where lower rarities cap: Grey max Lv.20, Green Lv.40, Blue Lv.60, Purple Lv.80, Gold Lv.100.

details.unit: Enhancement Points per single gear piece (one level step)
details.columns: Each row is one gear level; per-rarity value is the points for that level (null = that rarity cannot reach this level).

entries.name: Enhancement points gained per consumed piece tier
entries.summary: Enhancement Points GAINED when a gear piece is consumed as material, by the piece's tier: Grey 10, Green 30, Blue 60, Purple 150. Gold pieces give N/A (cannot be used as enhancement fodder).

details.note: This is the inverse of enhancement-points-requirements: that entry is the points NEEDED per level; this is the points a piece YIELDS when fed as material. Gold ('N/A') is not consumable for points.

entries.name: Gear mastery levels (bonus, forgehammer cost, stat multiplier)
entries.summary: Gear Mastery (Mastery Forging) levels 1-20. Unlocks at Town Center level 20 and lets you upgrade Mythic Hero Gear beyond its regular levels; gear must first be at level 20. Each level grants a +% bonus, costs Forgehammers, applies a stat multiplier, and from level 11 onward also requires Mythic Pieces.

details.prerequisite: Gear must be upgraded to level 20 before Mastery Forging can be used.
limitations: Only works on Mythic Hero Gear (not Epic, Rare, or Uncommon).
Mythic Gears above Mastery Forging level 10 cannot be used as material.
Red Gears cannot be used as Mastery Forging materials.
details.material_refunds: You get all the Enhancement XP back. Half of the Forgehammers are returned if the gear had Mastery Forging levels.

columns.bonus_percent: The +% bonus granted at this mastery level.
columns.forgehammer: Forgehammers required to reach this mastery level.
columns.stat_multiplier: Stat multiplier applied at this mastery level.
columns.mythic_pieces: Mythic Pieces required (null for levels 1-10; starts at level 11).

entries.name: Exclusive Gear weapon level widget cost
entries.summary: Hero-specific Exclusive Gear (e.g. Jabel's weapon) upgrades from Weapon Level 1 to 10 using Widgets. Cost is +5 Widgets per level (5 -> 50), totalling 275 Widgets to fully upgrade one piece.

details.purpose: Widgets are parts used to unlock and upgrade Hero Exclusive Gear.
details.availability: Only for Mythic Heroes (e.g. Jabel's Greaves of Faith).
details.effect: Boosts the hero's power massively and unlocks new skills.

entries.name: Hero Gear Enhancement basics
entries.summary: Hero Gear Enhancement upgrades hero equipment using Enhancement XP Parts or by merging other gears. Unlocks at Town Center level 15. Mythic (Gold) gears cannot be used as merge material. XP yielded per consumed gear depends on its rarity.

details.important: Mythic (Gold) Gears cannot be used as merge material.
details.note: XP requirements increase gradually from level 1 to 100. Cross-ref: full per-level table in 'enhancement-points-requirements'. Source discrepancy: this 'key levels' source lists level 90 = 1810, while the full per-level table lists 1910 for level 90 gold; kept both verbatim.

entries.name: Red Gear (Imbuement) requirements and levels 101-200
entries.summary: Red Gear is the tier above Mythic, reachable via Imbuement, extending gear levels from 101 to 200. Every 20 levels from 101 requires special materials (Mithril + Mythic Gears); regular levels in between require only XP. Max XP requirement reaches 9,300 at level 199.

details.rule: Every 20 levels after 101 requires special materials (Mithril + Mythic Gears); regular levels in between require only XP.
details.max_xp_note: Maximum XP requirement reaches 9,300 at level 199.
